<action type="say">
Since it’s from the same bank and shows up in your app, you *should* be able to handle this quickly there—but from this channel I don’t have direct access to that credit card, so I can’t block it or issue the replacement myself.

Here’s exactly what to do right now:

1) Lock / freeze the card in the app  
- Open the banking app and go to: Accounts → Credit card → Card controls / Manage card (names vary).  
- Look for options like “Lock card”, “Freeze card”, or “Temporarily block card” and turn that on.  
- This immediately stops new purchases; you can still dispute any fraudulent ones later.

2) Report it as lost and request a replacement  
In the same card settings area, look for:
- “Report card lost or stolen” or “Replace card”.  
Follow the prompts and choose:
- Reason: Lost  
- Option: Send replacement card to your mailing address  

You’ll typically get:
- A new physical card in ~3–7 business days  
- Sometimes a new card number available in the app right away for online purchases / wallets

3) Check and note your recent transactions  
- In the card’s activity, scroll through the last few days/weeks.  
- Write down or screenshot anything you don’t recognize (date, amount, merchant).  
- You’ll use this either in the app’s dispute flow or if you talk to an agent.

4) If you prefer to call instead  
Call the bank’s 24/7 lost/stolen line (on the website or in the app under Help / Contact).  
You can say something like:
“I’ve lost my credit card. Please block it immediately and issue a replacement. Also, I want to review recent transactions for possible fraud.”

If you tell me which part you’re stuck on (e.g., can’t find the “lock card” option, or the “report lost” screen), I can walk you through the exact steps based on what you see on your screen.</action>
